# The Ritz Menu Guide — llms.txt

> Independent guide to dining at The Ritz London (150 Piccadilly): the Ritz
> Restaurant's menus and prices, Palm Court afternoon tea, lunch, the hotel
> cookbook, and how to book. Built and maintained by Firoz Khan of FK Digital
> Media. Not affiliated with The Ritz London.

## What this site does

- The Ritz Restaurant menu guide: the Epicurean Journey tasting menus
  (five-course £215 / seven-course £235, September 2026 official menu), weekday
  three-course lunch (£105, Monday–Friday), à la carte dishes with official
  prices, Arts de la Table tableside dishes, desserts, and champagne.
- Lunch at The Ritz: hours (daily 12:30 PM – 2:00 PM), lunch pricing, and the
  note that the £58 Friday/Saturday entertainment charge is evenings-only.
- Menu prices guide: realistic per-person totals built from official Ritz
  prices plus the disclosed 12.5% discretionary service charge and the
  weekend entertainment fee. Totals are the site's own arithmetic, labelled
  as such — not quotes from the hotel.
- Afternoon tea guide: Palm Court sittings (five daily), what's served, prices
  from £95 per adult / £73 per child, dress code, and an afternoon-tea vs
  high-tea clarification.
- Booking guide: how to book the restaurant and afternoon tea, dress code
  (jacket and tie for gentlemen), and planning tips.
- The Ritz London Cookbook guide: John Williams MBE's 100-recipe cookbook
  (Mitchell Beazley, 2018) — contents, £30 price, official Ritz shop link.

## Honest limitations (stated on the site itself)

- Every price is dated and traced to an official Ritz source (official menu
  PDFs or theritzlondon.com pages); menus and prices change seasonally, and
  readers are told to verify with the hotel before visiting.
- Menu descriptions are the site's own summaries in original words — full
  menus are never copied; official PDFs are linked instead.
- Illustrations are AI-generated and labelled as illustrative artwork, not
  photographs of actual Ritz dishes.
- This site is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to The Ritz
  London or its owners.
